purpose: Original plan E4: test whether existing candidates have complementary development errors before any further training or release change.
allowed_input: Only already saved external_dev and external_dev_matched predictions; no reserved/test scores. These development images have been reused for model selection.
combination: Equal-weight mean of logits reconstructed from scores clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6]; no blend-weight search. Both input checkpoints uncalibrated at temperature 1.
advance_gate: At least +0.02 mean AUC over the baseline on BOTH as-distributed and matched development protocols; no domain real FPR increase greater than 0.02 at the diagnostic threshold 0.5. A pass only advances to calibration, attribution and a new independent evaluation design; it does not replace the released model.
frozen_release_unchanged: v0.2.0; original final evaluation is not rerun or relabeled as blind evidence for a new candidate.
